review_input: Fresh local unit tests, JSON schema checks, git diff check, protected-path inspection and independent invalid-response probes

evidence: inference_api/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m unittest discover -s inference_api/tests -v: 10 tests passed on 2026-10-14
test_invalid_server_response_is_preserved_as_response_error exercises malformed JSON and a JSON response with missing choices through models.infer and service.execute_run
Existing route, read-only SQL, evidence, payload, failure, verifier, citation and concurrency tests still pass
notes: The follow-up adds the round-one missing client-to-snapshot coverage without weakening the earlier boundary tests.

evidence: SPEC.execution.json and completion.json pass PowerShell Test-Json against their declared schemas
The invalid-response ModelOutput remains serializable after a JSON round trip and retains its evidence bundle, response stage and exact Base64 body
notes: The response contract uses raw_text=null for a response that has no valid textual answer and keeps the returned server material under model_output.serving.

evidence: models.infer reads the completion body as bytes, stores raw_response_bytes_b64 and raises ModelResponseError with a serving record for malformed JSON or an invalid chat shape
service.execute_run converts ModelResponseError into a ModelOutput and response_error before calling append-only storage.create_run
An independent probe preserved non-UTF-8 bytes and a JSON response with non-text content exactly across snapshot JSON serialization
notes: Round-one finding P1 is resolved: invalid response bytes, parsed or replacement-decoded representation, endpoint, evidence and stage now reach the immutable snapshot.

evidence: The updated completion evidence conforms to .codex/schemas/project-spec-completion.schema.json
This follow-up review conforms to .codex/schemas/project-spec-review.schema.json
No working-tree changes were reported under FineTuning, BancoModeloUse/dados_simulados or runpod
The first review remains preserved as review_round1.json with SHA-256 E68FAE5D503BCEE1D80F7E7720F6F5801DF373DBD4E2E56772A612314FABEC02
notes: The follow-up performed no RunPod, ngrok, database write, import, commit or push.

evidence: VAL-004 still proves the outbound request contains only the selected model, prompt, question, serialized evidence bundle and declared generation parameters, with no backend credential or database handle
Browser-supplied sql remains rejected before a source connection and the bundle contains only backend-owned fixed SQL for provenance
Gold set remains outside the runtime; numerical truth and causality remain not_checked and remote serving remains unvalidated
notes: The fix changes failure evidence only and does not expand the scientific claims or remote execution scope.

findings: Round-one P1 is resolved. Malformed JSON, non-UTF-8 bytes and structurally invalid chat responses are classified as response_error and preserve the exact returned bytes in model_output.serving.raw_response_bytes_b64.

Round-one P2 is resolved. The new contract test crosses models.infer and service.execute_run for malformed JSON and missing choices, while the fresh 10-test suite preserves AC-004 and the earlier VAL-004 boundary checks.
evidence: Fresh follow-up validation on 2026-10-14: all 10 inference_api unit tests passed and git diff --check exited 0.
For malformed JSON, models.py catches JSONDecodeError or UnicodeDecodeError, records a replacement-decoded text view plus lossless Base64 bytes and raises ModelResponseError.
For parsed JSON with absent choices, missing message/content or non-text content, models.py records the parsed response plus lossless Base64 bytes and raises the same response-specific error.

service.py catches ModelResponseError, creates ModelOutput(schema_version=2, raw_text=null, cited_evidence_ids=[], serving=preserved_record), updates observed model metadata and records status=response_error with error.stage=response.

The independent probe used bytes ff 00 followed by not-json and a JSON body whose content was numeric. Both snapshots retained byte-for-byte equality after JSON serialization, response_error, response stage, evidence bundle and raw_text=null.
AC-004 is sustained by the no-model-call cases, model failure, empty response, preserved invalid response, preserved verification failure and invalid citation tests.

VAL-004 remains sustained by exact outbound payload inspection, equality between the saved bundle and response-agent input, rejection of a browser sql field before source access and manual runtime-path inspection.

The changed_files inventory in completion.json is deduplicated: inference_api/src/inference_api/models.py appears exactly once, every listed path has count one and the completion artifact still conforms to its schema.

The implementation still does not prove a remote vLLM run, served weight hashes, shared browser operation or scientific accuracy; those limits remain explicit and do not block this local SPEC contract.
